findings.description: The KMS key used to encrypt the audit trail bucket does not set enable_key_rotation = true, so the customer-managed key material is never automatically rotated, extending the blast radius of a compromised key (CIS AWS Foundations requires rotation for customer-created CMKs).

No explicit key policy is defined, so AWS applies the default policy that delegates full key access to the account root (and thus to any IAM principal granted kms:* via identity policy). For a key protecting audit trail data this fails least privilege and provides no guardrail against unauthorised decrypt or key deletion.
